Ava (Docs): Heads-up: opened a PR to standardize examples for streaming + pagination + retry/backoff across Python/TS/Go. Goal: remove the legacy `cursor` pattern, show idiomatic async iterators, and add a short note about retry defaults. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/859

Marco (SDK): I can own TS+Go snippets. Any gotchas to call out?

Ava (Docs): Thanks. Please update these pages: /docs/api/streaming, /docs/guides/pagination, /docs/sdks/js-streaming.md, /docs/sdks/go-examples.md. Also add a one-line blurb in /docs/reference/client-config mentioning default retry=3 with exp backoff.

Jin (DevEx): For Python include sync + async. Keep old method names to avoid breaking users but show recommended patterns. Example async pattern I'd prefer:
```py
async with client.responses.stream(model="rwd-large", input="Summarize") as stream:
    async for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.output_text, end="")
```

Priya (Docs): Can we add a short migration note: "If you previously relied on `cursor`, switch to streaming iterators or page tokens where appropriate". Small paragraph under pagination guide.

Marco (SDK): TS draft I'll add:
```ts
const stream = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-large', input: 'Summarize' })
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.output_text)
}
```
And Go will use the streaming iterator in the client: short example in the PR.

Ava (Docs): Sweet. Also call out runtime limitation: streaming + KV cache isn't available on quantized tiny models (e.g., rwd-tiny-q). Put that under "Known limitations" on the streaming page.

docs-ci-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link found in /docs/guides/pagination -> anchor `#cursor-example` (old).

Ava (Docs): I'll fix the anchor and update the style guide note about stable anchors. Marco, please re-run link-check locally before pushing.

Marco (SDK): Will do. Branch: docs/snippets/stream-pagination-859. I'll push TS+Go patches tonight including the runtime caveat + client-config link. Assigning @Jin @Priya for review.

Jin (DevEx): I'll add a tiny regression test in the snippets repo to assert streaming yields JSON chunks with `output_text` keys. That should be quick tomorrow.

Priya (Docs): I'll add the migration paragraph and a short changelog blurb for the release notes.

Ava (Docs): Great. Once CI green we can merge. If docs-ci flags anything else ping me. Thanks all :rocket:
